headline: Revenue grows year over year while profit cools sequentially
summary_short: Masimo's Q1 FY2026 revenue was $403.6M, up 8.5% y/y but down 2.2% q/q; net income of $57.1M swung to a profit from a $170.7M year-ago loss, though it fell 16.4% q/q from $68.3M.
summary_long: Revenue was $403.6M, up 8.5% y/y from $372M but down 2.2% q/q from $412.5M. Gross margin was 62.1%, up ~220bp q/q and down ~76bp y/y. Operating income fell 4.1% y/y to $77.4M; EBITDA was roughly flat y/y at $85.5M. Net income of $57.1M swung positive from a $170.7M year-ago loss, though down 16.4% q/q. Diluted EPS was $1.09 versus a $3.17 loss per share a year earlier.
